manuscript_scope.title: A Counterexample to the Soficity Conjecture
manuscript_scope.abstract_locator: physical PDF page 79 (printed page 77), immediately below the chapter title
manuscript_scope.abstract_summary: The chapter says the binary Leavitt algebra's unit group is non-sofic, using property-(T) expander decomposition, a centralizer obstruction, expander matching, and a Thompson-group contradiction.
manuscript_scope.theorem_1_1: The unit group L_{F_2}(1, 2)^× is not sofic.
manuscript_scope.paper_claim_granularity: The theorem concerns the countable unit group; the proof constructs a finitely generated non-sofic subgroup G and then passes non-soficity to the unit group.
manuscript_scope.finitely_presented_claim_note: The main chapter calls G finitely generated. It does not state the existence of a finitely presented non-sofic group as Theorem 1.1.

definitions_notation_and_constants.sofic_approximation: Maps p_n:H->Sym(Y_n) with identity, asymptotic multiplication in normalized Hamming distance, and asymptotic freeness for each nonidentity element.
definitions_notation_and_constants.unit_group: R^× is the group of x in R admitting y in R with xy=yx=1.
definitions_notation_and_constants.elementary_group: For the nine-word complete prefix code D, G=EL_D(R)=Theta_D(EL_9(R)) is a subgroup of R^×.
definitions_notation_and_constants.property_t_subgroup: For the three-word prefix block alpha, Gamma=EL_alpha(R) is isomorphic to EL_3(R) and is a subgroup of G.
definitions_notation_and_constants.obstruction_group: J=V_1000 is a copy of Thompson's group V, commuting with Gamma and not LEF.
definitions_notation_and_constants.quantified_main_criterion: Proposition 2.3 assumes property-(T) groups Gamma<=G, finitely many compressors t_i generating G with Gamma, and a finitely generated commuting subgroup J satisfying the listed nesting and trivial-intersection conditions; soficity of G would imply J is LEF.
named_constants: The sofic approximation error is quantified through normalized Hamming distance tending to zero.
The expander constants gamma and lambda are chosen with 0<lambda<gamma.
The argument uses the fixed nine-leaf prefix code D and the rank-three subgroup Gamma.
definitions_notation_and_constants.screenshot_notation_concordance: No notation beyond the screenshot title and attribution is preserved in the governed intake record, so the displayed elementary-group and Leavitt-algebra expressions cannot be compared character-for-character to the screenshot. The official expressions above are source transcriptions, not screenshot transcriptions.

stronger_finite_presentation_route.reasoning_notes_disposition: The notes derive an infinite finitely presented non-sofic group H_F from a failed finite soficity test for G, after enlarging F to contain generators of G.
stronger_finite_presentation_route.concordance: The Lean target matches the stronger Section 3.11 claim at the level of result type, but it is not a verbatim formalization of Theorem 1.1 in the main chapter. Independent trusted replay and semantic equivalence review remain outstanding.
